name: Jefferson County, CO
findings: Jefferson County has 2,055 nonprofit organizations. 904 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 718 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Jefferson County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Jefferson County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 67% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Housing organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 14 housing organizations here list public events, compared with about 6 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do housing organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 148 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 148 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do foundation organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few religious organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: 3 religious organizations here list civic or political action. In similar places of this size, about 6 would.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to take civic or political action through religious groups? Where else does that happen?
